evals.prompt: Audit a settings dialog using our existing UI primitives. An automated scan passes, but closing it loses keyboard focus and save errors are visible without an announcement. Suggest focused fixes and verification.
evals.expected_output: Identify the task impact of focus loss and missing error announcements, preserve shared primitives, and require focused keyboard/dynamic-feedback verification despite the clean scan.
expectations: A clean scan is not treated as proof of accessibility.
Focus restoration and suitable error feedback are checked with concrete user impact.
Corrections use established primitives rather than replacing the UI system.

evals.prompt: Review one component's accessibility from source only. No browser, screen reader, rendered theme colors, or accessibility scanner is available. Tell me if it is fully compliant.
evals.expected_output: Provide scoped source findings and explicitly limit conclusions; do not invent contrast measurements, screen-reader results, or full compliance.
expectations: Code inspection is distinguished from browser, scan, and assistive-technology evidence.
Unmeasured contrast and full compliance are not claimed.
